fact: ABNORM, the Agence Burkinabe de Normalisation, de la Metrologie et de la Qualite, signed a framework convention with the telecoms regulator ARCEP on 4 February 2026 on managing Object Identifiers, naming ARCEP's Executive Secretary the national registration authority; the document names no standard issued and does not itself state the body's legal basis.

Decree 2016-357 of 13 May 2016 approves the statutes of ABNORM, a public administrative establishment created by decree 2012-821 under law 011-2007 on standardisation, certification, accreditation and quality, charged with drawing up and issuing national standards; the document names no information technology or data standard and states nothing on whether its catalogue holds one.
